# ABINIT real-output fixtures

These files were generated by local ABINIT 10.0.3 calculations of primitive
diamond Si on 2026-09-26, using the conda-forge x86_64 build under Rosetta.
They are output-format regression fixtures; their low-cost settings are not
converged material predictions.

- `si_scf_10.0.3.abo`: real SCF output, including the force table and output-variable arrays.
- `si_relax_10.0.3.abo`: real variable-cell relaxation with ionic convergence evidence.
- `si_bands_10.0.3.abo`: real band-path calculation output.
- `si_anaddb_10.0.3.out` and `si_10.0.3_PHBST.nc`: matching phonon frequencies
  for 12 q-points (six branches per point). The text contains Hartree and
  inverse-centimetre blocks; NetCDF `phfreqs` contains energies in eV.

The Si Troullier-Martins LDA tutorial pseudopotential came from
<https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abinit/abipy/master/abipy/data/pseudos/14si.pspnc>.
Its SHA-256 is
`3fb98731545d0734058bc5fec3c2ba80447a14e83095e1b2782b62b016d5400f`.

`tests/test_abinit_real_formats.py` verifies the parsers against these fixtures
without executing ABINIT. To generate a fresh full set of runs and an evidence
archive, use `scripts/abinit_demo.py` as documented in the project README.
The demo samples an 81-point phonon path; its artifact dimensions therefore
differ from this compact 12-point fixture.
